links.outcome: Per-turn triage action accuracy, including preserving the ask-for-more-information step
links.effect: Unprompted macro-F1 31.2 to 50.4; prompted 46.9 to 63.4. When correct action was to ask for more information, only 33.5% of prompted outputs preserved the step.
links.quote: Prompted models often recommend care before needed clarification is obtained; when the correct action was to ask for more information, only 33.5% of prompted outputs preserved the step.

links.outcome: LLM triage macro-F1 on a source-grounded benchmark of intended-use action selection
links.effect: Unprompted macro-F1 ranged from 31.2 to 50.4; prompted 46.9 to 63.4, with substantial threshold errors remaining.
links.quote: Unprompted macro-F1 remains low, ranging from 31.2 to 50.4.

unlisted_practices: Minimal prompting to improve triage action selection (improved 10 of 11 models but errors persisted)

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM triage performance across unprompted vs prompted protocols to test whether prompt instructions safeguard action timing and triage decisions.

primary.practice: prompt engineering / prompt guardrails for triage
